column1: # Conjugation exceptions: lemmas whose class the rules in classrules.tsv do not give. A row also applies to
# lemmas that end in it (알아듣다 → 듣다), unless a longer row matches. Homographs carry the class
# inline in the lexicon (묻다:REG "bury"); the row here is the more frequent reading.
#   class   REG HA D B BWA S H REU REO U EU L COP EXIST NC
#   flags   hon-si: the lemma ends in the honorific 시 (계세요, not only 계셔요); ae: an ㅎ stem whose vowel becomes ㅐ (그렇다 → 그래); whole: the row matches only the whole
#           lemma, not a suffix (죽이다 is not the copula)
# ㅂ irregular verbs and the ㅂ adjectives that are regular
# ㅎ: regular adjective, and the 그렇다 group
# productive adjective suffixes (ㅂ irregular): a lemma that ends in them takes their class and, when the
# lemma is not in lemmas.tsv, their pos

column5: 시 is the stem (꼬셔요), not the honorific
시 is the stem (적셔요), not the honorific
